policy: Release is blocked by any open P0 or P1 issue. P2 issues require owner, target month, and accepted-risk notes.

issues.title: Invite-only beta still needs broader representative trip coverage beyond current automated fixtures
issues.acceptedRisk: Current release-candidate gates prove the launch fixture matrix, regional generated actuals, Athens public share, multi-itinerary public-share flows, and production health. The prompt contract now enforces 60 representative fixtures across friend groups, couples, families, solo travelers, budget, premium, food, nightlife, outdoors, culture, and six regions, plus a 25-trip beta-representative generated-actuals preset. The next beta phase still needs that 25-trip generated-actuals run plus 25-50 real or representative trip reviews before public launch.

issues.title: Production visual-diff review cadence should mature from artifact capture to routine human review
issues.acceptedRisk: Automated visual gates currently fail on overflow, app errors, clipped text, overlap, and selected pixel diffs. Launch signoff now requires a fresh production visual review register that tracks the live production commit and deployment URL, verifies reviewed screenshots exist for every production visual result, confirms required public routes and stable diff routes, and records owner, cadence, next review date, protocol, verdict, and blocking findings. The P2 remains open until this cadence has routine human review history through beta and scale rehearsal.
